01-basics.q: Which of these is a communications service under Florida CST?
01-basics.why: Video, including streaming, is a taxable communications service. Web hosting is an information service, and phones and late fees are excluded.

01-basics.q: What are the three components of CST?
options: State, county and city sales tax
State CST, gross receipts tax and local CST
Federal excise, state and local tax
Sales tax, surtax and use tax
01-basics.why: CST has a state portion (s. 202.12), a gross receipts portion (s. 203.01) and a local portion (s. 202.19).

01-basics.q: How must the tax appear on the customer's bill?
options: As one combined “taxes and fees” line
Separately, as Florida CST and local CST
It may be included in the price if the bill says so
01-basics.why: Dealers must separately state the Florida and local communications services taxes and may not absorb them.

01-basics.q: A purchaser pays the tax to the dealer. Who is then liable if the dealer never remits it?
options: The dealer, because paying the dealer relieves the purchaser
01-basics.why: The purchaser is liable until the tax is paid; payment to the dealer relieves the purchaser.

02-rates.q: What is the total Florida CST rate on most services, before local tax?
What is the rate on direct-to-home satellite service?
02-rates.why: Satellite is taxed at 9.07% + 2.37% = 11.44%, and local tax does not apply.

02-rates.q: A family's home landline is billed $40. Which parts of CST apply?
options: Only the 2.37% gross receipts tax and the local tax
02-rates.why: The residential exemption removes only the 4.92% state tax and the 0.15% gross receipts tax.

02-rates.q: Which service can get the residential partial exemption?
02-rates.why: Mobile, video and satellite service never get the exemption. A home VoIP line can.

03-local-tax-and-rounding.q: A jurisdiction's total local rate is made of:
options: The state rate plus the county rate
Its adopted rate plus the county surtax conversion rate
03-local-tax-and-rounding.why: The Department publishes the adopted rate plus the county surtax conversion rate as one total.

03-local-tax-and-rounding.q: Tax computes to $2.534. What is charged?
03-local-tax-and-rounding.why: Carry to three decimals; round up only if the third decimal is 5 or more. 4 is less than 5.

03-local-tax-and-rounding.q: Which must always be rounded separately?
options: The local tax, apart from the Florida CST
Each customer's bills for the year
03-local-tax-and-rounding.why: Local tax is always rounded separately; the Florida CST has three permitted rounding options.

03-local-tax-and-rounding.q: Until when may a local CST rate in effect on January 1, 2023 not be increased?
options: It can be increased any time

04-registration.q: A company with four store locations sells VoIP service. How many CST registrations does it need?
04-registration.why: One registration is required for each legal entity, regardless of the number of locations.

04-registration.q: Which business does not need to register for CST?
options: A web hosting company that sells only hosting
04-registration.why: Information services such as web hosting are not communications services.

04-registration.q: What does a new dealer receive with its Certificate of Registration?
04-registration.why: New dealers receive DR-700014 and DR-700015.

04-registration.q: A dealer changes from a sole proprietorship to a corporation. What is required?
04-registration.why: A change of legal entity or ownership requires a new registration.

05-taxable-services.q: Which is excluded from the definition of communications services?
05-taxable-services.why: Internet access, email and similar online services are excluded.

05-taxable-services.q: A hotel charges a guest for a pay-per-view movie. Is it subject to CST?
05-taxable-services.why: The Department's FAQ says hotel pay-per-view movies are subject to CST.

05-taxable-services.q: A law firm faxes documents for a client as part of its legal services. Is CST due on the fax?
options: No, fax in the course of professional services is not taxable
05-taxable-services.why: Fax is taxable except when provided in the course of professional or advertising services.

05-taxable-services.q: A condominium association includes cable in its monthly fee without stating a separate charge. Does it collect CST from owners?
05-taxable-services.why: Per the Department's FAQ, it does not collect CST when the cable charge is not separately stated.

06-sales-price-bundling.q: Which charge is taxable even if separately stated on the bill?
06-sales-price-bundling.why: Voice mail is one of the charges always included in the sales price.

06-sales-price-bundling.q: A dealer lists its universal service fund fee as a separate line. May it exclude that amount from the sales price?
06-sales-price-bundling.why: Dealer expenses such as USF fees do not reduce the sales price.

06-sales-price-bundling.q: A bundle of TV and Internet access is sold for one price with no breakdown. When can the Internet portion be left out of the tax?
options: When the dealer can reasonably identify it from books and records kept in the regular course of business
06-sales-price-bundling.why: That is the books-and-records rule in s. 202.11(13)(b)8.

06-sales-price-bundling.q: Which is not part of the CST sales price?
options: The sale or recharge of a prepaid calling arrangement
06-sales-price-bundling.why: Prepaid calling arrangement sales are excluded from the CST sales price.

07-sourcing.q: What is the service address for mobile service?
options: Where the phone is used most this month
The customer's place of primary use
The billing address, wherever it is
07-sourcing.why: Mobile service is sourced to the place of primary use: the residential or primary business street address in the licensed service area.

07-sourcing.q: Satellite TV is received at a Florida home but billed to an Ohio address. Where is it sourced?
options: The Florida location where it is received
07-sourcing.why: Video and satellite service are sourced to where they are received in Florida.

07-sourcing.q: A calling-card call's service address is:
options: The central office for the area code and first three digits of the originating number
07-sourcing.why: That is the rule in s. 202.11(14)(a)2.

07-sourcing.q: A private line circuit has 3 termination points in Florida and 1 out of state, $1,000 a month, not billed by segment. What is the Florida taxable amount?

08-address-database.q: How often is the Department's Address/Jurisdiction Database updated?
08-address-database.why: It is updated every six months, with changes effective January 1 and July 1.

08-address-database.q: Which method does NOT earn the 0.75% collection allowance?
08-address-database.why: Methods other than the Department's database, a certified database or ZIP+4 earn 0.25%.

08-address-database.q: A dealer files on time but pays 20% of the tax late. What happens to the allowance?
08-address-database.why: Since October 1, 2015, a late payment disallows only the late percentage. A late return loses it entirely.

08-address-database.q: What is the penalty for failing to report local tax on Schedule I?

09-exemptions.q: A county pays its phone bill directly and has given the dealer a customer application identifying it as a county. Is CST due?
09-exemptions.why: Sales to the state and its political subdivisions are exempt when paid directly and documented.

09-exemptions.q: What may a dealer keep to document a government P-Card purchase?
options: A copy of the card's face, or the tax-exempt number, account number and cardholder name
A signed letter from the employee

09-exemptions.q: What does a 501(c)(3) religious institution give the dealer?
options: A signed certificate stating the purchases are for a qualifying religious institution
09-exemptions.why: The rule requires a signed certificate; the IRS letter is not required.

09-exemptions.q: If the dealer documented an exemption properly and the Department later finds tax due, who pays?
09-exemptions.why: The Department looks to the customer when the dealer met the documentation requirements.

10-resale.q: When does the CST Annual Resale Certificate expire?
A Transaction Resale Authorization Number is valid for:
May a buyer use its sales and use tax resale certificate to buy communications services tax-free for resale?
options: No, the CST certificate is separate
10-resale.why: The CST Annual Resale Certificate is separate from the sales tax certificate.

10-resale.q: A dealer sells for resale without proper documentation. Who owes the tax?
10-resale.why: A sale for resale is excluded only in strict compliance; otherwise the seller is liable.

11-prepaid-calling.q: How is the sale of a prepaid phone card taxed in Florida?
options: Sales tax at 6% plus any surtax
11-prepaid-calling.why: Prepaid calling arrangements are excluded from CST and taxed under s. 212.05.

11-prepaid-calling.q: A prepaid refill is bought online and nothing is shipped. Where is the sale sourced?
options: The customer's address or the location associated with the mobile number
11-prepaid-calling.why: That is the rule in s. 212.05(1)(e).

11-prepaid-calling.q: Is more tax due when the buyer uses the prepaid units to make calls?
11-prepaid-calling.why: No additional sales tax or CST is due on use of the units.

11-prepaid-calling.q: What is the status of TIP 12ADM-02 on prepaid communications services?

12-use-tax-direct-pay.q: A consumer buys taxable service from a seller that does not collect Florida CST. What should the consumer file?
12-use-tax-direct-pay.why: Consumers report use tax on DR-700019; registered dealers use DR-700016.

12-use-tax-direct-pay.q: When is a DR-700019 for the period ending June 30 late?
12-use-tax-direct-pay.why: It is due July 1 and late after July 20.

12-use-tax-direct-pay.q: Which situation can qualify for a CST direct pay permit?
options: Most services bought originate outside Florida and terminate in Florida
12-use-tax-direct-pay.why: The other basis is when taxability is known only on use.

12-use-tax-direct-pay.q: How long does a direct pay permit last?
12-use-tax-direct-pay.why: Rule 12A-19.030 sets a five-year term with renewal on DR-700032.

13-filing-paying.q: When is a CST return late?
options: After the 20th of the month after the period
13-filing-paying.why: Due on the 1st and late after the 20th, with weekend and holiday rollover.

13-filing-paying.q: Who must file and pay electronically?
options: Dealers that paid $5,000 or more in the prior state fiscal year
13-filing-paying.why: The threshold is $5,000 paid during the prior July-to-June fiscal year.

13-filing-paying.q: By when must an electronic payment be initiated?
options: 5:00 p.m. ET on the business day before the 20th
13-filing-paying.why: A confirmation number must be received by 5:00 p.m. ET on the business day before the 20th.

13-filing-paying.q: A dealer had no taxable sales this month. Must it file?
options: Yes, a return is required for each period
13-filing-paying.why: A return must be filed for each reporting period, even if no tax is due.

14-dr700016.q: Where do residential landline sales go on Schedule I?
14-dr700016.why: Residential sales are exempt from the 5.07%, so they go in Column C (2.37% and local) but not Column B.

options: Summary of Schedule I, Column F, Line 3
14-dr700016.why: Line 1 is the tax at 4.92% + 0.15% from the Schedule I summary.

14-dr700016.q: Where is direct-to-home satellite tax reported?
14-dr700016.why: Schedule II, with the total in Column C going to Line 4.
The instructions say Line 12 cannot be a negative number.

15-rate-changes.q: A city adopts a new local CST rate in June. When is it effective (outside the freeze)?
options: Bills dated on or after the next January 1
15-rate-changes.why: Changes apply to bills dated on or after the January 1 after adoption.

15-rate-changes.q: By when must the city notify the Department?
15-rate-changes.why: Notice is due by September 1 before the January 1 effective date.

15-rate-changes.q: How much notice must the Department give dealers?
Service was provided in December 2025 but billed on January 5, 2026. Which rate applies under the January 2026 TIP?
options: The new rate, because the bill was issued on or after January 1, 2026
15-rate-changes.why: The rates apply to all bills issued on or after January 1, 2026, regardless of when service was rendered.

16-refunds-audits-penalties.q: How long does a customer have to request a refund of CST from the dealer?
16-refunds-audits-penalties.why: The written request must be submitted within 3 years after the tax was collected.

16-refunds-audits-penalties.q: A return is filed and paid 45 days late. What is the late penalty rate?
16-refunds-audits-penalties.why: 10% for each 30 days or fraction: 45 days is two periods, so 20%.

options: A Notice of Intent to Audit Books and Records (DR-840)
16-refunds-audits-penalties.why: The DR-840 starts the 60-day period, which the taxpayer may waive.

16-refunds-audits-penalties.q: What is the usual audit lookback period?
16-refunds-audits-penalties.why: Typically three years, longer for non-filers or substantially incorrect returns.

17-capstone.q: In the capstone, why does the Orlando mobile plan revenue go in Column B?
options: Mobile service never gets the residential exemption
17-capstone.why: Mobile service is fully taxable, including the 5.07%.

17-capstone.q: Why are the prepaid refill cards left off the CST return?
options: They are exempt from all tax
They are taxed under the sales tax law instead
17-capstone.why: The sale of prepaid calling arrangements is taxed under s. 212.05, not CST.

17-capstone.q: Mangrove's Line 5 is $8,716.80. What is its collection allowance if on time?
Mangrove reported $552.00 of local tax to Orlando (5.52%) that belonged elsewhere. What is the decrease in Orlando's taxable sales on Schedule IV?
